profile.summary: Bharat Gears Limited manufactures and supplies automotive gear in India, the United States, Mexico, Spain, and internationally. The company provides gear products, such as ring gears, pinions, transmission gears, shafts, differential gears, and bevel gears; automotive components, including automotive clutch assemblies and components, turbochargers and related parts, driveline products, axle shafts
